about: Mission is a district municipality in the Fraser Valley, on the north bank of the Fraser River east of Maple Ridge, not a city. Downtown sits on a terrace above the river; rural benches, lakes, and the Westminster Abbey hill rise behind it. The district mixes a small urban core with acreages toward Stave Lake. About 42,000 people live in Mission.
